sources.title: Lambda 10-3 - Sutter Instrument
sources.evidence: Official product page describes Lambda 10-3 as an optical filter changer/filter wheel controller with shutter control and USB/serial interfaces.

sources.title: Lambda 10-3 Operation Manual
sources.evidence: Manual introduction states Lambda 10-3 is a filter wheel and shutter control system for rapid wavelength-path changes.

decision.name: Sutter Lambda 10-3多滤光轮控制器
decision.description: Sutter Lambda 10-3 是用于显微成像等光学实验的高性能多滤光轮控制器，可同步控制最多 3 个滤光轮及快门，实现快速滤光片切换与激发/发射通道管理。
decision.description_en: The Sutter Lambda 10-3 is a high-performance multi-filter wheel controller for microscopy and optical imaging workflows. It supports synchronized control of up to three filter wheels and shutters for rapid filter switching and excitation/emission path management.
